# DigiScale Infotech

> Think Digital, Scale Smart.

DigiScale Infotech is a premier web development, custom software engineering, and AI automation company based in Surat, Gujarat, India. We build high-performance websites, enterprise web applications, custom Shopify e-commerce stores, mobile applications, and AI-driven workflow automations for startups, SMEs, and global enterprises.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Custom Web Development**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, and Cloud Architectures.
- **Shopify & E-Commerce Engineering**: Custom Shopify theme development, headless Shopify storefronts, private apps, payment gateway integration, and conversion optimization.
- **AI Automation & Workflow Engineering**: Custom AI agents, LLM integrations, automated business workflows, web scraping, and API integrations.
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps using React Native and Flutter.
- **Custom Software & Enterprise SaaS**: Scalable cloud platforms, CRM/ERP integrations, REST/GraphQL APIs, and microservices architecture.
- **UI/UX Design & Brand Strategy**: User-centric interfaces, design systems, interactive prototypes, and digital product design.

1. **Modern Tech Stack**: Specialized in high-performance frontend frameworks (React/Next.js) and robust backends (Node.js/Python).
